_comment: Merge these two vault hooks into the `hooks` object of your ~/.claude/settings.json. Do NOT paste this file wholesale over settings.json if you already have other hooks — merge each array. Replace {{CLAUDE_DIR}} with the absolute path to your .claude directory (e.g. C:/Users/you/.claude), using forward slashes. `python` must be on PATH; if not, replace it with the absolute executable path. The installer does both substitutions for you.
